snapshot.title: Contractor mission generation system
snapshot.description: Hybrid procedural + AI mission generation from reusable templates. Claude API (Haiku) for narrative text. Location always from TESS/asteroid feed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Template structure defined: mission_type, mineral, quantity, location (variable), narrative_tone, payout_tier
Procedural assembly: location injected from live TESS/asteroid feed at generation time
AI text generation: Claude Haiku generates mission title + description + contractor quote from scaffold
Generated text cached per mission instance
Variety target: no text repeat within 5 consecutive missions per contractor
Contractor project phases advance and are reflected in dialogue

changes.newValue:
## Summary
Server: POST /api/generate-mission in web/server.js — calls Claude Haiku (claude-haiku-4-5) via Node https, returns {title, description, contractor_quote}. In-memory cache keyed on contractor+mission params. Variety tracking: last-5 contractor_quotes per contractor_id to avoid repeats. Affinity level → phase label in prompt (initial→strategic partnership). Graceful procedural fallback if API key not set or call fails.
GDScript: MissionNarrativeAPI.gd — static HTTPRequest helper that mirrors server cache locally. LaunchpadSelectorPanel renders blue mission briefing card in trip contract brief when a contractor is selected.
